organisers.source: the school's Reception Autumn 2 knowledge organiser

big.q: Who in the community keeps us safe and healthy?
big.a: Firefighters, paramedics, doctors, nurses, dentists, police, teachers and the lollipop person.

big.q: Who in the community helps us?
big.a: Shop workers, bus drivers, postal workers, builders, cleaners, mechanics and refuse collectors.
Something unexpected that needs action straight away.

big.q: Why is it important to help others? When have you been helpful?
big.a: No set answer: let your child tell you, using "I think… because…".

words.m: something sudden and serious that needs help straight away
the people who come to help in an emergency
saving somebody who is in danger
a person trained to give emergency care to people who are hurt or ill
a vehicle that takes people to hospital
a job someone does for a long time, taking on more as they go
food and habits that keep you strong and well

organisers.mathsHome: Read and write numbers to 10, and spot them out and about.

areas.s: Asking questions, learning rhymes and songs, show and tell, talk partners, new words, and saying ideas in full sentences: "I think… because…".
areas.home: Tell your child about your job: what you do and who it helps.

areas.s: Phonics (Phase 2), starting to read short phrases and sentences, forming letters, non-fiction books, and acting out and retelling Rama and Sita.
areas.home: Share books about people who help us.
areas.site: the caption game (phrases) and letter trace

areas.s: Sharing and taking turns, talking about feelings, respecting differences, anti-bullying. Keeping safe: strangers, roads, online, medicines, fire, keeping clean and brushing teeth.
areas.home: Read a picture book about friendship, differences or families.

areas.s: Using tools for fine motor skills, dance, balance and finding space, and sitting well at a table.
areas.home: Feel your pulse sitting still, then again after jumping for a minute.

areas.s: Family trees and generations, special achievements, transport through time. Celebrations: Bonfire Night and fire safety, Remembrance Day, Christmas.
areas.home: Look at family photos together and talk about them.

areas.s: Making up stories in pretend play, music and dance, painting to music, collage and group art.
areas.home: Role play people who help us: a vet, a firefighter, a shop worker.
